$comment: Ghost teams + scripted season arc for The Amazing Race Canada: Yassa Edition. Placements are SCRIPTED and never computed. Tokens usable in any line: {team} = player's team name, {points} = points earned this leg, {done} = challenges completed, {total} = challenges available.

teams.name: Team Maple
teams.personality: The strong rivals. Friendly, fast, and never far in front. They high-five you at every mat.

teams.name: The Rock Hoppers
teams.tagline: If we can climb it, we can win it.
teams.personality: Cheerful daredevils from Newfoundland. They laugh their way up anything and never, ever quit.

teams.name: Prairie Thunder
teams.personality: Ranch kids who run first and read the map later. Lightning quick, hopelessly lost.

teams.name: The Tide Riders
teams.personality: Laid-back surfers from Nova Scotia. Always almost late, always smiling anyway.

maple.farewell: Ava: "We had so much fun. Go win it, {team}!"
maple.onOtherElimination: Liam: "Safe travels, friends. That was a great race."
maple.finale: Ava: "We always knew {team} was the team to beat."

rockhoppers.farewell: Finn: "We climbed every rock we could find. Worth it!"
rockhoppers.onOtherElimination: Rose: "Big hugs. You made us race harder."
rockhoppers.finale: Finn: "You got us at the line, {team}. What a finish!"

prairie.farewell: Wyatt: "We were fast. We were just fast the wrong way!"
prairie.onOtherElimination: June: "Aw, no. Ride safe, you two."
prairie.finale: June: "We were cheering for {team} the whole way home."

tide.farewell: Coco: "Late again. But what a ride, eh?"
tide.onOtherElimination: Marlow: "That is rough. Catch you back home."
tide.finale: Marlow: "Told you. {team} had the good vibes."

legs.title: Meet the Teams
ceremonyLines: Welcome to The Amazing Race Canada, {team}!
Four teams are here to race you across Ontario and Québec.
Say hello. Tomorrow, none of them will slow down for you.

intros.tease: Keep your eye on Team Maple. They are quick, and they are polite about it.
The Rock Hoppers are not scared of anything. Anything at all.
Prairie Thunder start fast. Can they find the finish line?
The Tide Riders are never in a hurry. That could cost them.

legs.nextLegTease: Leg 1: cannons, forts and a very famous goat in Kingston.

legs.title: Kingston: Forts & Cannons
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number TWO!
First day of the race and you are already near the front.
This is a non-elimination leg — everyone races on!
Rest up. Tomorrow is the longest road of the week.
legs.closeCall: Team Maple beat you to the mat by six minutes. Six!

statsLines.heavy: You banked {points} points and finished every challenge at the fort — great for your season score! But Team Maple still ran the course six minutes faster.
statsLines.mid: {done} of {total} challenges done and {points} points banked for your season score. Team Maple just ran the course six minutes faster today.
statsLines.light: You banked {points} points for your season score. Team Maple ran the course six minutes faster — they were quick today!

legs.nextLegTease: Tomorrow: the long road to Montréal. Learn a French word tonight.

legs.title: The Long Road to Montréal
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number four.
A tough day. But look around — you are still in this race.
One team may be eliminated tonight.
Heads up. Old Montréal has secrets for you tomorrow.
legs.closeCall: The Tide Riders slid onto the mat one minute ahead of you. One minute!

statsLines.heavy: You worked so hard out there — {done} challenges and {points} points, all going to your season score. But The Tide Riders reached the mat just one minute faster today.
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score today. The Tide Riders simply ran the course one minute faster.
statsLines.light: You banked {points} points for your season score. The road was long, and The Tide Riders found the faster time by just one minute.

eliminationLines: Prairie Thunder... you were the fastest team out of Cornwall.
You were also two hours in the wrong direction.
I'm sorry to tell you... you've been eliminated from the race.
legs.nextLegTease: Tomorrow: the metro, a gold-star ceiling, and a science centre.

legs.title: Secrets of Old Montréal
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number three.
You rode the metro, found the stars, and did not get lost once.
This is a non-elimination leg — everyone races on!
You are climbing back. Keep going.

statsLines.heavy: {done} of {total} challenges and {points} points — all going to your season score. You're getting faster on the course every day.
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score today. Steady time on the course is what moves teams up the board.
statsLines.light: {points} points added to your season score. It was a short day, but your time on the course held your place.

legs.nextLegTease: Tomorrow: bagels, beasts and bugs. Bring your appetite.

legs.title: Bagels, Beasts & Bugs
ceremonyLines: {team}... you are team number ONE!
Your first win of the race. Look at that mat — it is yours!
But one team may be eliminated tonight.
From fourth place to first in two days. Wow.
legs.closeCall: Team Maple hit the mat forty seconds behind you. Forty seconds!

statsLines.heavy: {points} points and {done} challenges — all going to your season score. And your time on the course today? Fastest of everyone, by forty seconds!
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score, plus a first-place finish. Your time on the course beat Team Maple by forty seconds.
statsLines.light: {points} points added to your season score today. Your time on the course was still the best, by forty seconds.

eliminationLines: The Tide Riders... you found the bagels, the sloth and the fountains.
You just found them all a little too late.
I'm sorry to tell you... you've been eliminated from the race.
legs.nextLegTease: Tomorrow: a race down Autoroute 20 to the walled city of Québec.

legs.title: Race to the Walled City
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number two.
So close! Team Maple caught the funicular right before you.
This is a non-elimination leg — everyone races on!
Sleep well — the Citadelle is waiting.
legs.closeCall: Team Maple reached the mat barely a minute ahead. You could see them from the hill!

statsLines.heavy: {done} challenges and {points} points — all banked for your season score. Team Maple's time on the course was just one minute faster today.
statsLines.mid: {points} points added to your season score on a long driving day. Team Maple's time on the course edged you out by a minute.
statsLines.light: {points} points banked for your season score. The drive ate the clock, and Team Maple's time on the course was one minute quicker.

legs.nextLegTease: Tomorrow: the Citadelle, the noon cannon, and a goat named Batisse.

legs.title: The Citadelle Showdown
ceremonyLines: {team}... you are team number ONE!
Two wins in three days. You are racing like champions now.
And that means one team may be eliminated tonight.
legs.closeCall: You beat The Rock Hoppers to the mat by eight minutes. Your best gap yet!

statsLines.heavy: {points} points and {done} challenges — straight into your season score. Your time on the course beat The Rock Hoppers by eight minutes!
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score, and first place too. Your time on the course was the best of the whole field.
statsLines.light: {points} points added to your season score. Your time on the course was enough — eight minutes ahead of The Rock Hoppers!

eliminationLines: Team Maple... you led this race for five straight legs.
I'm sorry to tell you... you've been eliminated from the race.
legs.nextLegTease: Two teams left. Tomorrow: a hedge maze, dinosaurs, and a very long drive.

legs.title: Mazes, Dinosaurs & Ribs
ceremonyLines: {team}, you are team number two.
The Rock Hoppers got here by two minutes. Two minutes!
This is a non-elimination leg — everyone races on!
Tomorrow, one leg decides everything.
legs.closeCall: Two minutes. After eight hours of racing, that is all that separated you.

statsLines.heavy: {done} of {total} challenges and {points} points — all for your season score. Your time on the course was great, just two minutes behind The Rock Hoppers.
statsLines.mid: {points} points added to your season score on the longest day of the race. The Rock Hoppers' time on the course beat yours by two minutes at the maze.
statsLines.light: {points} points banked for your season score today. The Rock Hoppers found the faster time on the course at the maze and never looked back.

legs.nextLegTease: Tomorrow is the finale. Whoever reaches home first wins the whole race.

legs.title: THE FINALE: Race to the Finish
photoFinishLines: Two teams. One mat. Here they come!
The Rock Hoppers are right beside you...
ceremonyLines: {team}... you are the WINNERS of The Amazing Race Canada: Yassa Edition!
Eight legs, two provinces, and one unbelievable comeback.
You started this race in fourth place. You are finishing it as champions.
legs.closeCall: A photo finish! You crossed the mat one step ahead of The Rock Hoppers.

statsLines.heavy: {points} points and {done} challenges on the final day — all in your season score. And your time on the course? Just barely the fastest — a photo finish!
statsLines.mid: {points} points banked for your season score on the last leg. Your time on the course was exactly enough to win the photo finish.
statsLines.light: {points} points added to your season score, one perfect finish. Champions do not need to be fancy — just the fastest time on the course.

recapLines: Let's look back at your whole race, {team}.
Every leg, every badge, every photo.
Champions of The Amazing Race Canada: Yassa Edition!
legs.nextLegTease: You are home. Take the trophy — you earned every point of it.
